name: – Nathalie Loiseau – § 36 – Am 14
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 36. Opposes the repatriation to Europe of nationals of Member States who joined Daesh, including their partners or ex-partners and children; calls for their continued detention and prosecution in the region; stresses that those who joined a terrorist organisation must face justice and that protecting European citizens from returning jihadists must take priority;
